title: Acyclicity of external tensor coefficients
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], with $X,Y$ quasi-compact and with affine diagonals. Let $F,G$ be quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent] satisfying $H^p(X,F)=H^p(Y,G)=0$ for every $p>0$, where $H^p$ is module right-derived global sections [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. For the actual external tensor coefficients $E=\operatorname{pr}_1^*F\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G$ [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], one has $H^n(X\times_kY,E)=0$ for every natural $n>0$. This does not assert anything about a cochain comparison map or its normalization.

proof.text: Choose a finite affine cover of X. For each affine open V of Y, the section formulas identify Cech(X times V, external coefficients) with Cech(X,F) tensor G(V). Tensor over k is exact, so hF and affine Cech comparison give zero positive cohomology and Gamma(X,F) tensor G(V) in degree zero, naturally in affine V.
Use the affine-basis higher-direct-image presheaf description to identify pr2_* of the external coefficients with Gamma(X,F) tensor G and show that higher direct images vanish.

A basis of Gamma(X,F) identifies that sheaf with a direct sum of copies of G. Affine diagonal implies that Y is quasi-separated. The qcqs direct-sum cohomology comparison and hG make pr2_* acyclic; zero higher direct images are also acyclic.

For every p>0 and q, H^p(Y,R^q pr2_* E)=0: use the direct-sum acyclicity for q=0 and the zero higher direct images for q>0. The degenerate Leray edge consequently identifies H^n of the product coefficients with Gamma(Y,R^n pr2_* E), which is zero for n>0. All constructions apply to empty schemes, zero sheaves and infinite bases.

lean.statement: theorem picardExternalCupCoefficients_acyclic (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)] (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent] (hF : ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj F)) (hG : ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace p).obj G)) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace n).obj (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
